snippet.title: March 19: The Hidden Gift of Difficult Seasons
snippet.description:
COVID-19 is a difficulty season but it can be a gift if you use it to upgrade your focus on what is temporal to what is eternal.

If you would like the to find more encouragement and support, email office@jubileestl.org to join one of our online community groups.
